en.headline: Chinese Chamber urges population of 10 million and annual plan review
en.dek: The Chinese General Chamber of Commerce submitted more than 60 recommendations on Hong Kong’s first five-year plan, including a target of 10 million residents within a decade and a standing committee to review progress yearly.
body: The Chinese General Chamber of Commerce has put forward more than 60 policy suggestions on Hong Kong’s first five-year plan and the coming Policy Address, including a proposal that the city gradually raise its population to 10 million over the next decade to support Northern Metropolis development.

Chamber president Jonathan Choi Koon-shum described the Northern Metropolis as the top priority and called for a permanent committee comprising government, business, think-tank and academic representatives to review implementation at least once a year, with both binding and aspirational indicators.

Other proposals include elevating Hong Kong’s role from “super connector” to “super partner”, accelerating talent communities and international-school provision in the north, and piloting innovative institutional arrangements to attract industries such as biotechnology and artificial intelligence.

zh.headline: 中總倡十年人口達千萬 五年規劃設一年一檢委會
zh.dek: 香港中華總商會就首份五年規劃及施政報告提出逾60項建議，包括未來十年逐步提升人口至1,000萬配合北都發展，並成立常設委員會每年檢視進度。
body: 香港中華總商會就本港首份五年規劃及新一份施政報告提交意見書，提出逾60項政策建議，當中倡議政府未來十年逐步提升人口至1,000萬，以配合北部都會區發展。
中總會長蔡冠深形容北都發展是重中之重，建議成立由政府、商界、智庫及學界代表組成的常設委員會，至少每年檢視措施實施進度，並訂立約束力指標及預期性指標。
其他建議包括將香港角色由「超級聯繫人」升級至「超級合夥人」、在北都設立國際人才社區及國際學校配套，以及推行先行先試制度安排，吸引生物工程及人工智能等產業。
